sampling.method: 16 unique uint32 seeds drawn once from OS crypto RNG before confirmation outcomes; reject collisions against all historical layouts at freeze
sampling.inferenceScope: Paired synthetic-layout win tendency, not exact population mean or Elo confidence interval

adoption.method: one-sided exact paired-layout sign test; exclude exact .5 layout ties
adoption.null: probability of a positive layout conditional on non-tie is at most .5
adoption.stopRule: Complete all16layouts32games; no early stop, extension, parameter change or outcome-based replacement
adoption.previous144Games: exploration only; never pooled into confirmation significance

resourceNotes.all: 2000 ms per move, at most 4 search threads, 64 MiB TT budget. Persistent readiness outside clock; observation, sampling, protocol, search, stop/reap inside clock.
resourceNotes.mist: Both arms are current production HCE search with the same bounded map arena; candidate replaces only static evaluation with the pinned JQE network, including typed pool keys. 8 worlds when dark, 1 when fully revealed. Same 40 ms host and current core reserves. Candidate has neural accumulators and larger typed pool keys; total RSS and effective TT entry capacity are not equal.
resourceNotes.rules: Current engine.js: mate/stalemate first; three full checking cycles lose for responsible checker, not last mover. Other repetitions need ruling, never automatic draw. 120 quiet absent ruling is draw; 400 cap unresolved. Both engines retain current root long-check responsibility metadata.
